visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up on a deep metal wok filled with bubbling oil. A large perforated metal skimmer lifts golden-brown triangular pieces of food, letting oil drain. (2) Medium shot of the vendor's back; he wears a black long-sleeved shirt and blue jeans, standing at a stainless steel stall. He transfers fried food from the skimmer into a metal bucket. Steam rises. (3) Hands in plastic gloves hold a metal bowl of fried food. A green seasoning shaker is used to sprinkle light powder over the contents. (4) Extreme close-up of a piece of fried oden (tianbula) being held by chopsticks. It looks crispy and oily. Another dark rectangular piece (blood cake) is picked up. (5) A hand holds a clear plastic bag containing a large, round, golden-brown fried pancake with an egg folded inside. (6) Close-up on a flat black griddle where several round dough cakes are being shallow-fried in oil. A metal spatula flips one, revealing a crispy exterior. (7) A cross-section view of the pancake held in hand, showing layers of egg, meat, cabbage, and green herbs. (8) View of the street stall with a yellow sign. The camera pans out to show the stall under a corrugated metal roof in an urban street setting.
